meta.name: Draft League Season 4 VGC Reg F

rules.title: ⚔ DOUBLES DRAFT LEAGUE ⚔ RULEBOOK
rules.subtitle: Gen 9 VGC · Regulation F · 2v2 Partner Format
rules.footer: Questions or rule disputes? Contact the commissioner. Rules may be updated by group discussion before the season begins.

items.label: Game format
items.text: Pokémon Showdown — Gen 9 VGC Doubles, Regulation F rules. Bring 4, use 4.

items.label: Season length
items.text: 8 weeks. One match per week.

items.label: Match structure
items.text: Each weekly match is a 2v2: you are paired with a partner and face a team of two opponents. A match is a Best-of-3 series, one person piloting per side.

items.label: Partner rotation
items.text: You receive a NEW partner every week — no fixed partnerships for the season.

items.label: Balancing
items.text: Week 1: manual balancing based on previous season performance. Weeks 2+: balanced by current season Win/Loss ratio.

items.label: Pool size
items.text: Each player drafts 6 Pokémon total.

items.label: Draft order
items.text: Randomised snake draft. Order is randomised once before the draft begins.

items.label: Draft format
items.text: Asynchronous. Once the previous player submits their pick, the next player has 12 hours to make their selection. Pick ASAP to keep things moving.

items.label: Proxy picks
items.text: If you can't be available, tell the commissioner (or a readily available member) which Pokémon you want and they will submit on your behalf.

sections.heading: 3. DRAFT TIER RULES

items.label: Tier system
items.text: Pokémon are categorised as Top / High / Mid / Low. Limits per tier are set on the Setup tab.

items.label: Banned Pokémon
items.text: Certain Pokémon are marked Banned on the Pokémon List tab and cannot be drafted at all.

items.label: Restricted list
items.text: Regulation F's restricted Pokémon (marked DUber) cost 99 pts and are flagged if drafted — check with the commissioner before using.

notes: ⭐ TOP TIER SPECIAL RULE — Each player may DRAFT 2 Top Tier Pokémon, but may only BRING 1 from each player's pool per match (2 total per team of two).

items.label: Scheduling window
items.text: You have 1 week to schedule and complete your match. Extensions can be granted if genuinely needed — communicate early.

items.label: Coordination
items.text: Since you're coordinating 4 players instead of 2, scheduling may be harder. Do your best to find a time that works for all four.

items.label: Solo piloting
items.text: If one partner has zero availability despite best efforts, the other partner may pilot alone for that week. The match still counts.

items.label: Platform
items.text: All matches are played on Pokémon Showdown. Paste replay link(s) into the Schedule tab after your match.

items.label: Team building
items.text: You and your partner build a combined team from your two pools (2 players × up to 3 Pokémon each = 4 brought). You strategise together.

items.label: Series result
items.text: The team that wins the most games in the Best-of-3 series wins. Both partners on the winning team receive 1 Win; both on the losing team receive 1 Loss.

items.label: Tiebreaker
items.text: If standings are tied, the tiebreaker is Pokémon Differential: total Pokémon remaining alive on your team's winning games minus the opponent's remaining Pokémon on their winning games, summed across the season.

items.label: Recording results
items.text: After each match, enter player names, scores (games won), Mons Left for each team's winning games, and the replay link in the Schedule tab. Standings update automatically.

items.label: Setup tab
items.text: Enter your league's player names and team names. Set # of players, picks per player, and draft tier limits.

items.label: Pokémon List tab
items.text: Browse all Regulation F Pokémon with their draft tier. You can reassign tiers here if the league agrees on changes.

items.label: Draft tab
items.text: Enter each pick as the draft happens. Pokémon name auto-suggests via the dropdown. Draft tier auto-fills from the Pokémon List.

items.label: Rosters tab
items.text: Auto-populates from the Draft tab. Shows each player's full pool. Use the Apps Script menu (🎮) to add PMD portrait sprites.

items.label: Schedule tab
items.text: Fill in player names, scores, mons left, and replay links each week. Never touch Standings — it updates itself.

items.label: Standings tab
items.text: Read-only. Auto-calculated from Schedule. Sorted by Wins → Mon Diff.

items.label: Tier Tracker tab
items.text: Shows each player's pick counts per draft tier vs. their limit. Red = over limit, Green = within limit.
